question: Summarise My employment contract
answer:
Here is a summary of the private document:

Overview:
This is an employment contract between Orbitline Technologies Private Limited and Ms. A. Sharma, outlining the terms and conditions of her employment as a Senior Data Analyst.

Key points:
• The Employee is appointed as Senior Data Analyst in the Analytics department and reports to the Head of Analytics. (1. Position and Duties)
• Employment commences on 15 July 2026 and the Employee will be on probation for 3 months. (2. Commencement and Probation)
• The Employee will work from the Company office in Baner, Pune, with up to 2 days per week of remote work with manager approval. (3. Place of Work and Working Hours)
• The Employee will receive a fixed annual salary of INR 18,00,000, paid in 12 equal monthly instalments. (4. Compensation)
• The Employee is entitled to 21 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, 10 days of sick leave, and public holidays. (5. Leave)
• The Employee is covered by group health insurance of INR 3,00,000 per year for the Employee, spouse, and two children. (6. Benefits)
• The Employee shall not disclose any confidential information of the Company for 3 years after employment ends. (7. Confidentiality)
• All work products, inventions, software, and reports created by the Employee belong exclusively to the Company. (8. Intellectual Property)
• For 12 months after the end of employment, the Employee shall not solicit any employee or client of the Company to leave the Company. (9. Non-Solicitation)
• Either party may terminate employment by giving 60 days written notice or salary in lieu of notice. (10. Termination and Notice Period)
• This Agreement is governed by the laws of India, and any dispute shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Pune. (11. Governing Law and Disputes)

Watch out for:
• 15 July 2026 (start date of employment)
• 7 days written notice (termination during probation)
• 60 days written notice (termination after probation)
• 12 months after employment ends (non-solicitation period)
• 3 years after employment ends (confidentiality period)
• May (payment of performance bonus)
• Last working day of each month (payment of salary)
• 21 days of paid annual leave per calendar year (leave entitlement)
• 10 days of sick leave (leave entitlement)
• Public holidays (leave entitlement)
• INR 3,00,000 per year (group health insurance coverage)
• INR 1,000 per month (mobile phone expenses reimbursement)

question: Summarise Project Nimbus memo
answer:
Here is a summary of the document:

Overview:
This is a confidential document for the Analytics team of Orbitline Technologies Private Limited, informing them about Project Nimbus, a migration of the company's customer data platform from an on-premise data centre to a private cloud region.

Key points:
• The purpose of the memo is to inform Analytics team members about Project Nimbus, the migration of the company's customer data platform. (1. Purpose)
• Phase 1 of the project runs from 1 November to 15 December 2026, Phase 2 from 5 January to 28 February 2027, and Phase 3 is planned for the weekend of 17-18 April 2027. (2. Timeline)
• The approved budget is INR 4.2 crore, with INR 1.1 crore reserved for security testing and an external audit. (3. Budget)
• Analytics team members must complete the data inventory for their assigned client accounts by 15 December 2026, tag every dataset with its classification level, and attend the mandatory migration training on 12 November 2026. (4. Your Responsibilities)
• Information about Project Nimbus must not be shared with clients, vendors, or colleagues outside the distribution list until the public announcement planned for March 2027. (5. Confidentiality Rules)
• Any spend above INR 10 lakh needs approval from the CTO. (3. Budget)
• The on-premise data centre will be decommissioned by 30 June 2027. (2. Timeline)

Watch out for:
• 12 November 2026: Mandatory migration training
• 15 December 2026: Completion of data inventory and classification
• 5 January 2027: Start of Phase 2
• 28 February 2027: End of Phase 2
• 17-18 April 2027: Start of Phase 3
• 30 June 2027: Decommissioning of the on-premise data centre
• March 2027: Public announcement of Project Nimbus
• Breaches of confidentiality may lead to disciplinary action

question: Summarise Vendor services agreement
answer:
Overview:
This is a Master Services Agreement between Orbitline Technologies Private Limited (the Client) and Tessaract Infra Services Private Limited (the Vendor), outlining the terms and conditions of their partnership.

Key points:
• The Vendor will provide managed database hosting, monitoring, and 24x7 technical support for the Client's analytics platform (1. Scope of Services).
• The Agreement starts on 1 January 2027 and runs for 3 years, renewing automatically for further periods of 1 year unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the current term (2. Term and Renewal).
• The Client will pay a fixed fee of INR 6,50,000 per month, with late payments carrying interest of 1.5 percent per month (3. Fees and Payment).
• The Vendor guarantees 99.9 percent monthly availability of the hosted platform, with priority 1 incidents requiring a response within 30 minutes and resolution within 4 hours (4. Service Levels).
• All Client data must be stored and processed only in data centres located in India, with the Vendor notifying the Client of any personal data breach within 24 hours (5. Data Protection).
• Each party will keep the other party's confidential information secret during the Agreement and for 5 years after it ends (6. Confidentiality).
• Each party's total liability under this Agreement is capped at the fees paid by the Client in the 12 months before the claim, with the cap not applying to breaches of confidentiality or data protection obligations (7. Limitation of Liability).
• The Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving 90 days written notice, while either party may terminate for material breach if the breach is not cured within 30 days of written notice (8. Termination).
• On termination, the Vendor will return all Client data within 15 days and securely delete all remaining copies within 30 days, providing a written certificate of deletion (9. Exit and Data Return).
• This Agreement is governed by the laws of India, with disputes to be resolved by arbitration in Mumbai before a sole arbitrator (10. Governing Law and Disputes).

Watch out for:
• 1 January 2027 (start date of the Agreement)
• 90 days written notice (termination for convenience and material breach)
• 30 days written notice (termination for convenience)
• 24 hours (notification of personal data breach)
• 15 days (return of Client data)
• 30 days (secure deletion of remaining copies)
• 4 hours (resolution of priority 1 incidents)
• 30 minutes (response to priority 1 incidents)
• 1.5 percent per month (interest on late payments)
• 25 percent (capped service credit for each 0.1 percent of availability below the target)
